guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the strongest anomalies in the digest: latency-90 up 1641% (z=+328), mem up 886% (z=+177), cpu up 649%, and diskio rising from 0 to 9.26e9, while all other services (including productcatalogservice and currencyservice) are flat (|z|<1.6). Memory shows the largest resource shift, with the CPU and disk I/O increases plausibly secondary effects such as GC pressure or swapping, but the digest cannot fully rule out a disk or CPU fault as the primary one, and the logs contain no warning or error lines to confirm.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the recommendationservice pod and apply or raise its memory limit, then investigate the memory growth (leak or injected memory stress) before re-enabling normal traffic. Restarting a single stateless pod is non-destructive.
